Panthers Team List Round 12: Cleary named despite ankle concern

Nathan Cleary has been named at halfback for the Penrith Panthers in Round 12 of the 2026 NRL season, despite rolling his ankle in training on Wednesday.

Coach Ivan Cleary confirmed his son went through a full training session on Friday morning and is confident he will be fit to play. The Panthers face the Broncos at BlueBet Stadium on Saturday afternoon.

James Fisher-Harris has also been named in the starting side after missing Round 11 with a knee complaint. The experienced prop is expected to play a key role in combating Brisbane's powerful forward pack.

Jarome Luai returns from a one-match suspension to partner Cleary in the halves, while Api Koroisau has been named at hooker after recovering from a hamstring niggle.
